exposure: Neonates with very low birth weight
Neonates with extreme low birth weight
cohort: 976 newborns admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) in Al-Gomhoury Hospital Hajjah, Northwest Yemen
finding: Preterm birth, low birth weight, and traveling for more than 60 minutes to reach the NICU were significant predictors of neonatal death in newborns admitted to a NICU in Yemen.
mod_finding: Neonates delivered by Caesarean section had lower odds of death than those delivered by vaginal birth.
birth_weight: Low birth weight, very low birth weight, and extreme low birth weight neonates included
